 •    Breakeven step away followed? / yes
,

Daily Bias:
overall my daily bias was bullish since we were at all time highs.
Trade execution:
i woke up late so i just waited for 10am open to confirm the bullishness and waited for displacement above 10am. then i saw that the .79 level lined up perfectly with 10am. so i limited 10am with my stop at a protected low. honestly should’ve checked the 5 min and seen the 5 min rejection block we had which would’ve been the better trade. but it’s alright no need to stress its already passed.

i need to get up on time.

Day 1  

Maybe I had the wrong bias today, but first day on the fundeds again was a loss, 2 losses today

10 am opened higher which meant I wanted to look for shorts. The 28 point manipulation up looked good in my eyes and we formed a bearish smt when tapping the 10:05 5 min RB. Went to the 1 minute and took the 1 min rb at 10:16, gave a good reaction but sadly went up. 

I honestly didnt see NQ and ES going any higher after opening higher and expanding that much at market open, but maybe im wrong. I was looking for price to trade towards that big 15 minute gap, and my tp was at the start of the gap 

Took the loss, reentered the sweep, but didnt work out. 2 losses today, overall a bit below my max risk for the day

Overall didnt lose much, whats important is that I didnt start chasing like the other times. Took my losses and happy I didnt tilt, onto the next week (edited)

But half way through passing the account and see you guys next week!
